en.headline: Hong Kong Tennis Open main draw begins at Victoria Park
en.dek: The Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open main-draw matches start on Monday at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium, with Venus Williams among the players on the opening day schedule.
body: The main draw of the 2026 Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open begins on Monday at the Victoria Park Tennis Stadium in Causeway Bay. The WTA 250 event runs through 8 November on outdoor hard courts.

Organisers said the opening-day order of play includes a match between seven-time Grand Slam singles champion Venus Williams and Mary Stoiana, as well as the encounter between Hong Kong wildcard Adithya Karunaratne and sixth seed Wang Xinyu.
Top seeds include Sorana Cîrstea, Alexandra Eala, Leylah Fernandez and Maria Sakkari. Qualifying was completed over the weekend, and main-draw play is scheduled from 2 November.
Tickets for the tournament are available, with prices starting from HK$180 according to organisers. The stadium is located at Victoria Park.

zh.headline: 香港網球公開賽正賽今日在維園開打
zh.dek: 保誠香港網球公開賽單打正賽周一在維多利亞公園網球場展開，開幕日賽程包括維納斯·威廉姆斯的比賽。
body: 2026年保誠香港網球公開賽單打正賽周一在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園網球場開始。這項WTA 250賽事在戶外硬地進行，持續至11月8日。
主辦單位表示，開幕日賽程包括七屆大滿貫單打冠軍維納斯·威廉姆斯對陣馬莉·斯托亞納，以及香港外卡卡魯納拉特尼對陣六號種子王婧雨。
頭號種子包括奇爾斯蒂亞、埃亞拉、費爾南德斯及薩卡裡。資格賽周末完結，正賽由周一起舉行。
賽事門票有售，主辦單位指價錢由港幣180元起。場地位於維多利亞公園。
